mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM auth_principal_role_assignment assignment JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id AND capability.capability_code = #{capability} JOIN auth_data_scope data_scope ON data_scope.scope_id = assignment.data_scope_id WHERE assignment.principal_id = #{principalId} AND assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.valid_from <= #{at} AND (data_scope.valid_to IS NULL OR data_scope.valid_to > #{at}) AND data_scope.scope_type = 'LEGAL_ENTITY' AND data_scope.legal_entity_id = source.legal_entity_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_source source WHERE

SELECT source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.legal_entity_id, source.source_type, source.source_code AS code, source.display_name, source.status AS state, COALESCE(configuration.source_time_zone, 'UNKNOWN') AS time_zone, COALESCE(configuration.revision_number, 0) AS configuration_revision, watermark.committed_cursor AS committed_watermark, ( SELECT MAX(success.finished_at) FROM attendance_sync_job success WHERE success.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND success.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIALLY_QUARANTINED') ) AS last_successful_sync_at, source.row_version FROM attendance_source source LEFT JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id WHERE ORDER BY source.source_type, source.display_name, source.attendance_source_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_sync_job job JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = job.attendance_source_id WHERE

SELECT job.attendance_sync_job_id AS job_id, source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.display_name AS source_display_name, source.source_type, job.status AS state, job.page_count AS committed_pages, job.accepted_count AS raw_fact_count, job.quarantined_count, job.safe_error_code AS safe_error_summary, job.started_at, job.finished_at AS completed_at, job.row_version FROM attendance_sync_job job JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = job.attendance_source_id WHERE ORDER BY job.created_at DESC, job.attendance_sync_job_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_attendance_document document JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = document.attendance_source_id WHERE source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'OA_ATTENDANCE' AND

SELECT document.oa_attendance_document_id AS document_id, document.source_business_key AS source_document_id, document.source_version, document.document_type, document.source_status, CASE WHEN document.source_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS effective_candidate, NULL AS employee_number, normalized.interval_start, normalized.interval_end AS interval_end_exclusive FROM oa_attendance_document document JOIN attendance_source source ON source.attendance_source_id = document.attendance_source_id JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = document.normalized_attendance_record_id WHERE source.attendance_source_id = #{sourceId} AND source.source_type = 'OA_ATTENDANCE' AND ORDER BY document.knowledge_rank DESC, document.created_at DESC, document.oa_attendance_document_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
